definition{
  name: zeroFrom,
  parameters: [value : Bytes, offset : Nat, remaining : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match remaining
    | Nat.zero => true
    | Nat.succ rest => (match (prim index value offset : (Option UInt8))
      | Option.none => false
      | Option.some byte => (((prim to_nat byte : Nat) =? 48) && (zeroFrom value (offset + 1) rest)))),
  recursive_argument: remaining,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: byteIs,
  parameters: [value : Bytes, offset : Nat, code : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match (prim index value offset : (Option UInt8))
    | Option.none => false
    | Option.some byte => ((prim to_nat byte : Nat) =? code)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: nibble,
  parameters: [value : Bytes, offset : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match (prim index value offset : (Option UInt8))
    | Option.none => 0
    | Option.some byte => (if ((prim to_nat byte : Nat) <? 58) then (prim subtract (prim to_nat byte : Nat) 48 : Nat) else (prim subtract (prim to_nat byte : Nat) 87 : Nat))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: piece,
  parameters: [value : Bytes, start : Nat, count : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (prim slice value start count : (Option Bytes))
    | Option.none => 0x
    | Option.some part => part)
}

definition{
  name: wellFormed,
  parameters: [parent : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((not ((prim length parent : Nat) <? 55)) && ((Studio.Agent.Contributor::hexFrom parent 0 2) && ((not (Studio.Runtime::same (piece parent 0 2) 0x6666)) && ((byteIs parent 2 45) && ((Studio.Agent.Contributor::hexFrom parent 3 32) && ((byteIs parent 35 45) && ((Studio.Agent.Contributor::hexFrom parent 36 16) && ((byteIs parent 52 45) && ((Studio.Agent.Contributor::hexFrom parent 53 2) && (if (Studio.Runtime::same (piece parent 0 2) 0x3030) then ((prim length parent : Nat) =? 55) else (((prim length parent : Nat) =? 55) || (byteIs parent 55 45)))))))))))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: spanId,
  parameters: [span : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: (((prim length span : Nat) =? 16) && ((Studio.Agent.Contributor::hexFrom span 0 16) && (not (zeroFrom span 0 16)))),

}

definition{
  name: escapeFrom,
  parameters: [value : Bytes, offset : Nat, remaining : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match remaining
    | Nat.zero => 0x
    | Nat.succ rest => (match (prim index value offset : (Option UInt8))
      | Option.none => 0x
      | Option.some byte => (prim append (if ((prim to_nat byte : Nat) =? 34) then 0x5c22 else (if ((prim to_nat byte : Nat) =? 92) then 0x5c5c else (if ((prim to_nat byte : Nat) <? 32) then (prim append 0x5c753030 (hexByte (prim to_nat byte : Nat)) : Bytes) else (piece value offset 1)))) (escapeFrom value (offset + 1) rest) : Bytes))),
  recursive_argument: remaining,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: timed,
  parameters: [parent : Bytes, span : Bytes, actor : Bytes, instance : Bytes, start : Bytes, stop : Bytes, operation : Bytes, outcome : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (Studio.Runtime::number start)
    | Option.none => (timeRefusal start stop)
    | Option.some begun => (match (Studio.Runtime::number stop)
      | Option.none => (timeRefusal start stop)
      | Option.some ended => (if (ended <? begun) then (timeRefusal start stop) else (signals parent span actor instance start stop (prim subtract ended begun : Nat) operation outcome)))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: trace,
  parameters: [parent : Bytes, span : Bytes, actor : Bytes, instance : Bytes, start : Bytes, stop : Bytes, operation : Bytes, outcome : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (not (wellFormed parent)) then (formatRefusal parent) else (if ((zeroFrom parent 3 32) || (zeroFrom parent 36 16)) then (zeroRefusal parent) else (if (not (spanId span)) then (spanRefusal span) else (if (not (Studio.Observer::prismId actor)) then (actorRefusal actor) else (timed parent span actor instance start stop operation outcome))))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

  parameters: [value : Bytes],

  body: (match (Studio.Runtime::split value 9)
    | List.cons parent f1 => (match f1
      | List.cons span f2 => (match f2
        | List.cons actor f3 => (match f3
          | List.cons instance f4 => (match f4
            | List.cons start f5 => (match f5
              | List.cons stop f6 => (match f6
                | List.cons operation outcome => (trace parent span actor instance start stop operation (Studio.User::joinTabs outcome))

              | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
            | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
          | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
        | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
      | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374)
    | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
